role: item
symbolType: module
rule:
  all:
    - kind: mod_item

        field: name
        pattern: $NAME
transform:
  BODYLESS:
    replace:
      source: $DECL
      replace: '\s*\{[\s\S]*$|;\s*$'
      by: ''
  SIG:
    replace:
      source: $BODYLESS
      replace: '\n[\s\S]*$'

signature: '$SIG'
isExported:
  has:
    kind: visibility_modifier
    regex: '^pub'
